Enumeration Type Documentation

enum BtMsg_t

Message notifications between Connectivity Mananger Bluetooth plugin and the bluetoooth daemon.

Enumerator:
kBtMsgInitialize  Initialize notification (plugin to daemon)
kBtMsgShutdown  Shutdown notification ( plugin to daemon)
kBtMsgIsInitialized  initialized query ( plugin to daemon )
kBtMsgInitialized  Initialized notification (daemon to plugin)
kBtMsgNotInitialized  Not initialized notification ( daemon to plugin )
kBtMsgConnect  Connect request (plugin to daemon)
kBtMsgDisconnect  Disconnect request ([plugin to daemon)
kBtMsgIsConnected  connection query (plugin to daemon)
kBtMsgConnected  Connected notification (daemon to plugin)
kBtMsgDisconnected  Disconnected notification (daemon to plugin)
kBtMsgConnectPending  Driver is attempting connection (daemon to plugin)
kBtMsgConnectFailed  Bluetooth baseband connection failed.
kBtMsgAuthenticated  Profile authenticated
kBtMsgEncrypted  Profile encrypted
kBtMsgUnexpectDisconnect  Sent by individual profiles when they received an unexpected disconnect event
kBtMsgSleep  Sleep notification (plugin to daemon)
kBtMsgWake  Wakeup notification (plugin to daemon)
kBtMsgPinCodeRequest  Send pin code request msg. Sent by Bt Daemon
kBtMsgPinCodeResponse  Pin code response message. Sent by UI in response to Pin Code Request
kBtMsgPinCodeComplete  Pin code status message (fail or success) Sent by Bt Daemon regarding status. UI can present user with success or fail message and any needed UI updates
kBtMsgEnterSilentPair  Sent to silence system pairing dialog
kBtMsgExitSilentPair  Sent to re-enable system pairing dialog
kBtMsgGetSilentPairMode  Query sys app for it's pairing state
kBtMsgSilentPairEnabled  Sys bar app reports silent pairing is enabled
kBtMsgSilentPairDisabled  Sys bar app reports silent pairing is disabled
kBtMsgPairingDialogDisplay  Sent to invoke Pairing dialog
kBtMsgPairingDialogClosed  Sent to inform that pairing dialog is closed
kBtMsgRequestRadioOff  Message sent by application requesting radio off
kBtMsgRequestRadioOn  Message sent by application requesting radio on
kBtMsgRadioOff  Message sent by Daemon that Bluetooth radio is off
kBtMsgRadioOn  Message sent by Daemon that Bluetooth radio is on
kBtMsgSysbarRadioOn  Message sent by application to system bar to turn on radio
kBtMsgUnloading  Message sent by Daemon notifying apps that stack is unloading. Apps should close handles to the library and close handles to any Bluetooth drivers they access too
kBtMsgLoaded  Message sent by Daemon when Bluetooth stack finished loading.
kBtMsgDiscoverable  Message sent by Daemon when device is set to discoverable
kBtMsgNonDiscoverable  Message sent by Daemon when device is set to non-discoverable
kBtMsgTimedVisibility  Message sent by when app requests timed visibility
kBtMsgDiscoverableComplete  Message sent by btmgr to vis mgr when discover change has completed
kBtMsgNonDiscoveryComplete  Message sent by btmgr to vis mgr when discover change has completed
kBtMsgPaired  Message sent by btmgr to vis mgr when discover change has completed
kBtMsgTrustedDevRemoved  Message sent by btmgr to vis mgr when discover change has completed
kBtMsgDebugLevelOff 
kBtMsgDebugLevelError 
kBtMsgDebugLevelStatus 
kBtMsgDebugLevelMedium 
kBtMsgDebugLevelVerbose
